explication: Paperless-AI is a web application that automates document metadata generation and adds manual review, configurable classification, and RAG-based search and chat for a Paperless-ngx archive. The main automated workflow scans Paperless documents, requests AI analysis, then updates document metadata and records processing state. In the RAG workflow, the web API delegates indexing and search to a Python service; question answering also retrieves document content and uses the configured AI provider. README capabilities are included, but links for unsampled setup, manual, and rules implementations are limited to what the tree and excerpts support.
